subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: After the replay correctness blocker is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt persistent wake targeting and delivery replay as a supported part of the durable beta runtime?
rationale: The PR creates long-lived shared-state and cross-owner delivery semantics on top of a durable foundation that maintainers have not yet accepted; implementation correctness cannot decide the product, retention, repair, and support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor the wake layer
options.body: Accept the direction after crash-safe replay, upgrade, retention, rollback, and live delivery proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the durable stack
options.body: Keep approved runtime facts but defer persistent wake routing and replay until ownership and delivery contracts are narrower.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Do not adopt the cross-owner durable projection and continue improving existing task, subagent, and delivery owners.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the wake layer
recommendation.body: Accept the direction after crash-safe replay, upgrade, retention, rollback, and live delivery proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The upstream stack review already identifies this handle as the broadest available owner for the durable runtime product and ownership decision.
